name: filebeam
description: End-to-end encrypted file and note sharing by Vented.

scripts.build: npm run build:encryption && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=backend && vp check ui/src tests/browser playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts && npm run types:check --workspace=backend
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=backend && vp fmt ui/src tests/browser playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts
